customManagers.description: Multica CLI pin (ARG MULTICA_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> multica-ai/multica GitHub releases. Tag is `vX.Y.Z`, the ARG holds `X.Y.Z` (no `v`), so extractVersionTemplate strips the prefix.

asdf pin (ARG ASDF_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> asdf-vm/asdf GitHub releases. Upstream tags are `vX.Y.Z` and the ARG keeps the `v` (the download URL is built from the raw value), so no extractVersionTemplate is used: the release version is the tag text and is written back verbatim. semver-coerced only orders the `v`-prefixed tags; it does not rewrite them.
GitHub CLI pin (ARG GH_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> cli/cli GitHub releases. Tag is `vX.Y.Z`, the ARG holds `X.Y.Z` (the download URL adds the `v` itself), so extractVersionTemplate strips the prefix.

aws-sso-cli pin (ARG AWS_SSO_VERSION in Dockerfile) -> synfinatic/aws-sso-cli GitHub releases. Tag is `vX.Y.Z`, the ARG holds `X.Y.Z` (the download URL adds the `v` itself), so extractVersionTemplate strips the prefix.

FuelLabs/github-actions reusable workflow, SHA-pinned in docker-publish.yml. Upstream publishes no tags and no releases, so the built-in github-actions manager marks the ref `unversioned-reference` (enabled: false) and it never reaches the dashboard. Track the master branch tip instead: git-refs datasource + currentDigest, so a moved branch yields a digest bump that rewrites only the SHA.
